title: Fia Probable NDE 13083
content: When I was in grade 4, I had fever but my mom made me go to school anyway. On the third day of the fever, I wore a red jacket with a fur collar. It was my favorite jacket and made me feel better. Then I went to school. My friends questioned why I had come to school when I was sick. I didn't know how to answer that, so I walked away. I went to sit near the school, flag pole which was in the middle of a big field. I sat down and was looking around. My vision started to get bright, like something flashed in my eyes and then it was suddenly dark. I thought I fell asleep, but I saw my own body sleeping next to the flag pole. I could see that I was flying. I came down to check on my body. I thought to myself, 'This is so much fun because I can fly!' So, I decided to explore the town. I flew back home. On the way, I saw people going about their daily business. I saw my mom cooking and cleaning the house. I flew around my neighborhood some more. Then, I decided to go back to school. I flew back to the big field and I saw a bright light in the sky. On the other side of the light, it was very dark. The shape was unclear, but it looked like 2 centers of brightest and darkest portals. I was interested, but I didn't know which one I wanted to see first. Then I heard a voice from the dark portal saying, 'Come follow me.' When I looked over, I saw a thing that looked like the dementor in the Harry Potter films. But the color of the dementor was both light and dark; is how I can best explain it. There was also another entity on the other side. Now I found myself between 2 entities and I was looking at both of them. I followed that thing which called me to follow. But then, I heard the other entity yell at me, 'No it's not your time yet, go back.' Then, I felt like I got pulled back and then slammed into my body. I woke up in a state of shock. arrival.other_being_detail: One entity was described as looking like a 'dementor' (both light and dark). Another entity was on the other side near the light/dark portals and told her, 'No it's not your time yet, go back.'

environment.environment_other_detail: Two unclear 'portals' or centers: one bright light in the sky and on the other side very dark; described as '2 centers of brightest and darkest portals.'

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Fever (not considered life-threatening by the experiencer).

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Two portals (bright and dark) and two entities; one called her to follow, the other told her to go back.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE exploration of town/home occurred before encountering the light/dark portals and entities, followed by being told to return and re-entering the body.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Two portal-like centers (bright and dark) with two entities; one resembled a Harry Potter 'dementor' described as both light and dark.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: 'Come follow me.' / 'No it's not your time yet, go back.' / 'This is so much fun because I can fly!'
